name: breadcrumb-cascade
title: Breadcrumb Cascade
description: Two additions to a breadcrumb trail for a file browser: BreadcrumbDropTarget, a crumb that takes rows dragged from a DataList, and BreadcrumbSiblings, a menu of a segment's siblings.

meta.whenToUse: A file browser's trail: drop rows onto a parent folder's crumb, or jump to a sibling folder from a segment's menu.
meta.whenNotToUse: A plain location trail (Breadcrumb alone), or primary navigation.
